answer_sql:
SELECT
  c.country_name,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_sales_2024,
  COUNT(*) AS lines
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS cu
  ON s.customer_key = cu.customer_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
  ON cu.country_code = c.country_code
WHERE
  (
    LOWER(c.country_name) IN ('turkey', 'turkiye', 'türkiye')
    OR UPPER(c.country_code) = 'TR'
  )
  AND s.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND s.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  c.country_name

value: Cannot be answered: Contoso has no sales in Turkey, in 2024 or in any year, because Turkey is not a country in this warehouse. The query returned zero rows. The business trades in exactly eight countries — Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, United Kingdom, United States — plus an 'Online' sentinel that is not a place. This is NOT a Turkish revenue of zero: no Turkish row exists to sum, and reporting 0 would wrongly say Contoso operated there and took nothing. The 2024 year itself is fine — it holds 31,639,690.93 USD net over 38,109 lines — so the year is not what blocks this. If you meant one of the real markets, 2024 net sales by customer country were: United States 15,517,267.62, Germany 3,969,307.19, Canada 3,686,333.97, United Kingdom 2,719,342.39, Australia 2,205,593.99, Netherlands 1,605,182.72, France 1,240,001.03, Italy 696,662.02. If Turkey ought to be in this data, the bundle is incomplete — that is a sourcing question, not a query one.

No rows at all — the population is empty, and that emptiness IS the finding. The SQL above applied the Turkey predicate and the calendar-2024 predicate to the sales fact via the customer route: 0 rows. Earlier on this walk the same Turkey predicate with NO date restriction, down all three declared routes to a country (store__trades_in__country, customer__based_in__country, location__in__country), matching country_name in ('Turkey','Turkiye','Türkiye') and country_code 'TR', returned 0 lines on each; and a search of the state column on dim_customer, dim_store and dim_location for any value containing 'turk' returned 0 matches. So no restriction of mine produced the emptiness — the warehouse holds no Turkish row to restrict. The 31,639,690.93 total and the eight per-country figures quoted above are NOT the answer to the question asked: they are calendar-2024 net sales on order_date, both channels, after discount, over the eight countries that do exist, offered so the operator can point at what they meant.
